warrants.quote: In connection with its public offering the Company issued 108,181 warrants to purchase shares of the Company’s common stock with an exercise price of $6.5625 per share.

The warrants have an exercise price of 80% of the initial offering price, or $4.20 per share (based on the Company’s initial public offering price of $5.25 per share) and expire five years from the issuance date.
